Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited range of
motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the crash, and the clinical picture aligns
well with a cervical strain. Over the course of 21 visits, care proceeded along a conventional path, combining manual therapy,
targeted stretching, and graduated strengthening. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and function
returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the cervical region. No prior injury
or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each
service rendered, with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was released to
full activity with a home exercise program.
